run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-16T21:24:30Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate warning for otel-demo/frontend coincides with a burst of frontend error spans between the 21:24:00 and 21:33:00 samples: the frontend error counter sat at 1817 from 21:02:30 to 21:24:00, rose to 3748 by 21:33:00 and stayed flat through the last sample at 21:39:00. The increase came from the GET /api/data route and its grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds client span (+401 each) and, secondarily, from POST /api/checkout / grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder (+78). The ad service itself received no GetAds spans between 21:25:00 and 21:32:00 and recorded no GetAds error status, and 608 of 747 frontend GetAds error spans finished within 2 ms, i.e. the calls failed fast without a server round trip. At 21:23:26-21:23:30 the ad and payment Deployments were rolled out with a new pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt (ad 21:23:27Z, payment 21:23:26Z); the fresh pods were marked Ready immediately (no readiness/startup probe) but the ad application logged 'Ad service started, listening on 8080' only at 21:29:49 and the payment application logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' only at 21:24:51. That gap explains both the frontend GetAds failures (frontend error-rate alert) and the checkout-to-payment Charge failures. The flagd-config ConfigMap currently enables adFailure and paymentUnreachable, but the ad service's own spans and the cessation of the error burst while those flags still read 'on' argue against the injected flags being the effective mechanism; that remains an unresolved candidate. The trigger of the 21:23 restart, Jaeger error details (no traces after about 21:08) and the alert rule itself (no rule named RequestErrorRate returned) are not available.

claims.text: The frontend error-span counter sum(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{service_name="frontend",status_code="STATUS_CODE_ERROR"}) was 1817 at its first sample 21:02:30 and stayed 1817 through 21:24:00, then rose to 3748 by 21:33:00 (about 1931 new frontend error spans) and remained 3748 through the last sample at 21:39:00.

The frontend error increase is carried by span_name 'GET /api/data' (346 to 747, +401) and its client span 'grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' (346 to 747, +401), and by 'POST /api/checkout' (101 to 179, +78) with 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' (101 to 179); frontend 'tcp.connect' error spans rose 26 to 41 in the same interval.

The frontend GetAds ERROR spans were fast failures, not timeouts: of 747 cumulative error spans the histogram shows 608 at le=2 ms, 645 at le=4 ms, 653 at le=10 ms, 700 at le=100 ms and 747 at le=1000 ms.

In service_name="ad", the server span 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' counted 1429 at 21:25:00 and stayed 1429 through 21:32:00 (no GetAds requests reached ad), then 1448 at 21:33:00, 1510 at 21:34:00 and 1560 at 21:35:00, all with status STATUS_CODE_UNSET; ad's span names include 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds', 'getAdsByCategory', 'getRandomAds', 'resolve' and the two flagd.evaluation client spans.

ad's own error spans in the window are only flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream (2, unchanged) and flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean (112 to 180 at 21:33:00, 181 at 21:34:00); there is no error status on any 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' span.

Deployment otel-demo/ad carries pod-template annotation kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-16T21:23:27Z at revision 2, and Deployment otel-demo/payment carries kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-16T21:23:26Z at revision 2; of all 21 otel-demo Deployments these two are the only ones restarted in the incident window (flagd's restartedAt is 20:52:36Z, every other is null).

Events at 21:23:26-21:23:30 record the rollout: Deployment payment 'Scaled up replica set payment-5d565cf9b from 0 to 1', old pod payment-55766d76b9-9fxhp 'Stopping container payment' and its ReplicaSet deleted; Deployment ad 'Scaled up replica set ad-5f8dd7c58d from 0 to 1', old pod ad-554b849958-6z62j 'Stopping container ad'; new containers 'Started' at 21:23:29-21:23:30.

New pod ad-5f8dd7c58d-rtbj5 was created 21:23:27, its ad container started 21:23:29 and the pod reports Ready=True from 21:23:29 with no readinessProbe, startupProbe or livenessProbe and CPU limit 50m; new pod payment-5d565cf9b-8gwcn is Ready=True from 21:23:30 with no probes and CPU limit 20m.

The replacement ad container logged 'Ad service starting.' at 21:28:09 and 'Ad service started, listening on 8080' at 21:29:49, and its request-handling lines ('Targeted ad request received for [assembly]' etc.) only appear from 21:31:39 onward, so the application was not listening for roughly six minutes after the container started and after the pod was marked Ready.
The replacement payment container logged 'payment gRPC server started on port 8080' only at 21:24:51, and 'Charge request received.'/'Transaction complete.' pairs appear from 21:32:41 onward.

Service checkout produced its own error spans in the same window: its error counter was 12 at 21:25:00, 92 at 21:26:00 and 156 at 21:27:00, flat afterwards, on span names 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and 'oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge'.

frontend-proxy's own error spans rose on span 'ingress' (544 to 1048) and 'router frontend egress' (447 to 926) over the same 21:20-21:33 interval and then stayed flat; its error timings coincide with the frontend burst, but the propagation of frontend 5xx through the proxy was not verified from status codes or traces.

ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config (key demo.flagd.json) currently sets adFailure defaultVariant "on" (description 'Fail ad service') and paymentUnreachable defaultVariant "on" (description 'Payment service is unavailable'); cartFailure, adHighCpu, adManualGc, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, paymentFailure, productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure are "off".

frontend traffic continued through the incident: the frontend STATUS_CODE_UNSET span counter rose steadily from 79348 at 21:20:00 to 121536 at 21:38:00 while the error counter stopped rising at 21:33:00, so the burst ended rather than the traffic stopping.

Checked and found without restart: frontend pod frontend-675fd7b5c5-68tcg started 20:50:39Z with restartCount 0 and Ready=true; flagd pod flagd-78f7f46ddc-f756g started 20:52:36Z with restartCount 0; ad-5f8dd7c58d-rtbj5 and payment-5d565cf9b-8gwcn also show restartCount 0 and an empty lastState (no crash/OOM), so their unavailability was startup latency, not a container failure.

fraud-detection changed during the window for a different reason: its pod shows restartCount 1 with lastState terminated reason OOMKilled and exit code 137 (container re-Created/Started at 21:25:14 per events), while its own error-span counter stayed at 4 and moved only to 5 at 21:31, so no error-rate impact is attributable to it.

The frontend error-rate alert is caused by the ad Deployment rollout: the old ad pod stopped at 21:23:29, the replacement pod was advertised Ready (no readiness probe) while its application did not listen until 21:29:49, the ad service received no GetAds spans from 21:25:00 to 21:32:00, and frontend GetAds error spans failed within 2 ms or less, so the frontend's GET /api/data requests failed at connection level until the new ad pod began serving.

The fault-injection settings adFailure=on and paymentUnreachable=on in ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config are a candidate trigger for the 21:23:26-27 restarts of the ad and payment Deployments (their declared faults match the two failing call paths, frontend-to-ad and checkout-to-payment), but no evidence shows they were the effective mechanism at the time of the burst.

The flagd fault settings do not match the observed failure path: ad recorded zero 'oteldemo.AdService/GetAds' error spans and received no GetAds spans from 21:25:00 to 21:32:00, the frontend GetAds failures completed in 2 ms or less (no server round trip), and the frontend error counter stopped rising at 21:33:00 and the checkout error counter at 21:27:00 even though flagd-config still reads adFailure="on" and paymentUnreachable="on" at 21:44:40.

Add a startup/readiness probe to the ad and payment containers (gRPC health check on port 8080) so a pod is not marked Ready before its application listens, and review the very low CPU limits (ad 50m, payment 20m) that plausibly stretched their startup; the current pods are Ready with no probes at all.

Establish from cluster audit/change history who applied the kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt annotation to Deployments ad and payment at 21:23:27Z/21:23:26Z and whether the adFailure/paymentUnreachable ConfigMap edits were meant to be activated; flagd itself was last restarted at 20:52:36Z, so the running flagd may not hold the current ConfigMap contents.

Why the ad Node application took 21:23:29 to 21:28:09 to log 'Ad service starting' and 21:29:49 to listen is not established; the 50m CPU limit is only a plausible contributor (hypothesis).

The flagd pod log query returned no lines (status no_data, 0fbc577d-8f39-4d0a-9387-3ffe108be385-t1:d6a83cb1-9fb8-4197-945e-29467bfa7eb2), so flagd sync/reload activity at the time of the incident is unknown.

A NetworkPolicy query for namespace otel-demo returned no objects (status no_data, c285e2be-14fc-4403-9aa0-e03c9dc8a80b-t1:2236d80b-8563-4555-8441-efcf6fc8b311) and is not citable, so a policy/network cause is neither confirmed nor excluded. A query for metric rpc_client_duration_milliseconds_count returned no_data (05433c0a-c7f7-4390-a9ca-401d35a34df5-t0:17ae272c-0ddb-4209-96a3-8cbb0ae7975e, cf08a52e-55d9-468a-bab0-86498ed119d7-t2:df6a4260-9b3c-4e93-8bd6-6b02499d29f6), so gRPC client status-code labels were unavailable.

Services absent from the error-counter result (for example cart, currency, email, product-catalog, shipping, image-provider, quote) had no error series returned in that query; their error state is unknown, not proven zero.
next_steps: Check cluster audit logs or the change-history owner for who patched Deployments otel-demo/ad and otel-demo/payment with kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt at 21:23:27Z/21:23:26Z and why.
Confirm whether the flagd flags adFailure and paymentUnreachable were meant to be active, and if so whether the flagd pod (last restarted 20:52:36Z) actually re-read ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config.
Add gRPC startup/readiness probes on port 8080 to the ad and payment containers and re-evaluate their CPU limits (ad 50m, payment 20m) so the pod is not Ready before the server listens.

If error detail is still needed for the frontend GetAds and checkout PlaceOrder failures, obtain traces or logs from a period when Jaeger/collector retention covers the 21:23-21:33 window, since this Run's Jaeger data ends around 21:08.
